resources.string: To silence notifications, place your phone face down on a flat surface. You\'ll feel a subtle vibration each time Pssst turns on.
Allow access to Do Not Disturb
To turn on Pssst, open your device\'s settings below, then turn on the switch next to Pssst.
Pssst needs Do Not Disturb access. Tap the switch to grant it.
When the phone lies face down
Required by Android so Pssst can watch the sensors in the background.
Flip your phone to silence it
This gesture turns on Do Not Disturb and stops most interruptions
